Public input and trust boundary

Public call: adapt(payload, certificate), from src/paid_source.py.
No ledger, prepared state, source callback, class factory, certificate verifier,
root table or numerical backend is a public argument.

payload is an exact tuple or exact list with three entries:
  (N, kappa, rows)
rows is an exact tuple or list of exactly N entries. Each entry is an exact
tuple or list (a_j,b_j), representing (a_j+i b_j)*2^kappa. Scalar fields must be
exact Python integers: bool and int subclasses are rejected. N is a power of
two in [4,4096]. Every numerator has at most 65536 magnitude bits; zero uses
one charged magnitude bit. kappa has at most 256 magnitude bits.

Only ordinary built-in containers are accepted, avoiding callbacks, custom
iterators and custom field access. This is an in-memory grammar, not a JSON,
network, text, pickle or hostile-Python deserializer. No caller mutation may
occur during a call. Later caller mutation is safe: the returned source retains
no mutable input container. Monkeypatching, hostile imports, object.__setattr__,
reflection into private state and interpreter tampering are outside the trusted
program model. Resolve the pinned buckets and compact_window modules from this
packet when importing the adapter, preserving the single accepted class identity.

certificate is an exact tuple or list of 17 entries in this order:
  0 producer: 'ALG034-SERIAL-FIXED-POINT-v1'
  1 target: 'U_negative(P_balanced_longer_first(x))'
  2 phases: 'ALG034-accepted-phase-embedding-v1'
  3 order: 'frequency-index-order'
  4 premise: 'I attest all accepted ALG034 producer, phase, rounding, range and input premises'
  5 input_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
  6 output_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
  7 N
  8 B_A
  9 a
 10 beta_A
 11 F_in
 12 W_in
 13 p
 14 t
 15 C
 16 original_input_zero, exact integer 0 or 1

Every text field is an exact str, at most 256 code points. Scientific integer
fields use the 256-bit metadata cap except C, which uses 16384 bits. Widths are
charged before their width rejection; fields after a rejected prefix are not
claimed to have been inspected. F_in is SIGNED, matching the accepted common
input grid 2^(-F_in). All scalar encodings remain paid, including very large
absolute exponents, p and t. The adapter never expands 2^p, 2^t or 2^kappa.

Common state constraints

N must match payload.N; 3<=B_A<=N; 0<a<N and a odd; 0<=beta_A<N. For this dyadic
N, odd a is exactly the coprimality condition. Blocks are the actual balanced
positive contiguous partition, longer blocks first. The accepted exact intended
phase embedding and frequency-index ordering are fixed by the tags and premise.
The map P is the accepted phase-weighted block map, without an added orthogonal
projection normalization 1/block_length.

Nonzero original-input contract

original_input_zero=0; W_in>=1; p>=W_in; t>=0; kappa=W_in-F_in-p.
Recompute H=min(binomial(N+B_A-1,B_A),2^(N-B_A)) and
C=64 H B_A 2^B_A N^2 exactly, then compare the declared C to that result.
The exact condition 2 C 2^(-p)<=2^(-t) must hold. This is the accepted condition;
the displayed upstream precision formula is a sufficient way to arrange it.

The trusted upstream party asserts that the original exact input really has
common grid exponent F_in and maximum Cartesian numerator width W_in, is the
input identified by input_sha256, and that the accepted specified serial
fixed-point producer ran with these exact states and precision. All accepted
phase accuracy, nearest-grid multiplication, exact index, normalization, stored
range, double-width accumulator and output-order premises apply. Its actual
returned array is this exact payload, with certified complex maximum-coordinate
error <= Delta=C*2^kappa from Y=U_N P_(a,beta_A)x.

The adapter recomputes no original input or producer trace. Merely writing the
attestation text does not make it true. If these assertions are false or do not
apply to this exact payload, the mathematical target-error conclusion does not
follow. Input and output digest labels provide identification and mismatch
checking; the theorem still requires true exact-payload binding independently
of digest collisions or forged declarations.

Exact-zero original-input contract

original_input_zero=1; W_in=p=t=C=kappa=0. F_in may remain any supported signed
metadata integer. All output numerators must be zero. This canonical zero
serialization is a deliberate v1 grammar restriction. The upstream party
asserts that the original input was exactly zero, rather than merely that a
finite-precision producer returned zero. The conclusion Y=0 is conditional on
that assertion. The adapter cannot distinguish a fabricated assertion by itself.

Output digest encoding

Start with ASCII bytes 'ALG034-OUTPUT-v1' followed by a zero byte. Append N,
kappa and then a_0,b_0,...,a_(N-1),b_(N-1), each encoded as follows:
  one sign byte (0 nonnegative, 1 negative);
  four-byte unsigned big-endian magnitude-byte length;
  the minimal unsigned big-endian magnitude bytes.
Zero has length zero and no magnitude bytes. SHA-256 of this complete byte
stream must equal output_sha256. All encoded byte lengths are below 2^32 under
these explicit caps. This format is independent of tuple/list choice and avoids
large decimal conversions. There is no public helper that manufactures a trusted
producer certificate; tests create explicitly synthetic fixtures.

Returned records

Every result is a frozen SourceResult with immutable nested fields and a frozen
Receipt. The exact Q16 DyadicSource is frozen and deeply immutable as constructed.
producer_contract stores the copied immutable declaration in documented order.
conditional_soundness is always CONDITIONAL_ON_TRUSTED_UPSTREAM_CONTRACT.

VALID_SOURCE: source is populated; alpha_exponent encodes alpha=2^alpha_exponent;
normalization_L and doubling disclose the normalization; delta=(C,kappa),
rho=(1,-Pq), requantization_error=(1,1-F), Pq=16m+16 and F=Pq+1.
target_budget is TARGET_BUDGET_PASS or TARGET_BUDGET_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

ZERO_APPROXIMATION: all declared output numerators were zero, but the original
input was declared nonzero. No normalized source/alpha exists. Delta is retained.
EXACT_ZERO_INPUT: all declared output numerators were zero under the separately
asserted exact-zero-input contract. No normalized source/alpha exists.
Both zero statuses carry target_budget=NO_NORMALIZED_SOURCE.

A semantic invalid input raises Rejection(code,path,receipt), preserving paid
work up to the rejection. Memory exhaustion or interpreter/runtime failures are
not converted into mathematical certificates or proof of host totality.
